text:
Alex K: Heads-up: docs PR #3124 (SDK snippets + migration guide) needs a merge timing decision for the next minor release. Preview: https://deploy-preview-3124--docs.redwood.com — CI preview is live but lint failed once. Who can review?

Maria G: Quick q — this is behind the feature flag `batching_v2`, right? If so we need to decide whether to ship docs in v2.3.0 or hold until 2.4.0 cutoff.

Alex K: Yes, it's gated by batching_v2. The code for the runtime change is in canary but we've already had customer requests for the SDK examples. My preference: land docs now with clear note + versioned copy for 2.2.x -> 2.3.0, and mark experimental.

Docs Bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-3124--docs.redwood.com — build #942 passed (unit tests), lint: 1 error — see CI: https://ci.redwood-inference/build/942

Ryan L: I can take a reviewer pass after lint fix. Error is minor (trailing comma in snippet). Will push a commit in a few. @Sophia P can you double-check migration wording?

Sophia P: Sure — I'll check migration section for clarity. Also propose a tiny example showing old->new client init.

Alex K: Example draft below, feel free to copy to the SDK snippets section:

```js
// v1 client (legacy)
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });

// v2 client (batching_v2)
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, batching: { enabled: true, batchSize: 64 } });
```

Maria G: We also need to ensure versioned docs: add a note in TOC and create a 2.2.x snapshot so customers on pinned versions aren't surprised. Can someone add the snapshot label?

Alex K: I'll add the snapshot commit after merge if we decide to land. But first we need release engineering sign-off for the merge window. @David H — what's the cutoff today for 2.3.0?

David H: For the 2.3.0 minor release the merge window for docs changes tied to feature flags is today 2026-03-24 16:00 UTC. If this doesn't merge by then, it goes into the next cycle (2.4.0). Also, please include a CHANGES.md entry with the feature flag callout and a short rollback note.

Alex K: OK — plan: Ryan will fix lint and request review, Sophia will review migration text, Maria will add version snapshot note, I will prepare CHANGES.md entry. Target: merge by 2026-03-24 15:30 UTC to give us buffer.

Ryan L: Fix pushed — PR now has one tiny change. CI preview recreated: https://deploy-preview-3124--docs.redwood.com (build #944).

Docs Bot: Build #944 — all checks passed ✅. Preview link: https://deploy-preview-3124--docs.redwood.com

Sophia P: Reviewed migration wording, added a short table for behavioral differences and a small code example for error handling. Left one nit about phrasing (suggested edit).

Maria G: Snapshot note added to TOC and pinned a 2.2.x copy under /v2.2.1/sdks. Also added anchor for experimental flag doc.

Alex K: CHANGES.md entry added: "SDK: document batching_v2 (experimental) — customers on pinned versions unaffected."

David H: Confirming merge go-ahead. I approve as release owner. Remember to tag the PR with `release:2.3.0` and `docs:experimental`.

Alex K: Tagged and merging now. Thanks everyone :tada:

Ryan L: LGTM — merging.

Docs Bot: PR #3124 merged by Ryan L at 2026-03-24T15:12:30Z. Preview will be promoted to prod after release cut.

Alex K: Great — leaving a follow-up task to monitor feedback for the next 48h and create a small eval to catch any doc-to-runtime mismatches.

Sophia P: I'll follow up with a quick smoke test on example flows and post results here.

David H: Thanks all — recorded in release notes and change log.

Maria G: Excellent coordination — saved the release window. :heavy_check_mark:
